result:
The end cards are not done: none of the screens I judged reached a 4 from the critic.

Screens 35, 38, 40 and 59 scored 3, and screen 60 scored 2. I did not run the critic on 76 or 77.

Shipped this run:
- **Screen 40 (What's New card):** v29.90 gives it a dim scrim, a 720px flat panel, a left-aligned title and one "Got it" button. It was a 1560px slab with no button. The critic gave it 3 and called it better than before.
- **Screen 60 (Abandoned):** v29.92 sets the title to the plain title colour, not dim grey. This was the only one-line fix the critic named that needed no ruling from him. I did not re-shoot or re-score it after the change.
- **Screen 59 (abandon confirm):** v29.89 shipped earlier. The title now asks "Abandon this run?", "Keep playing" is the amber button on top, and the card is 320px. It scored 3 after v29.90 and before v29.92.

All three passed the gate.

The critic's remaining findings, none shipped:
- **`$` in 35, 38 and 60:** the hero line and the loot-left-behind line use `$`, and the critic wants SP. My notes record that the haul line and credits use `$` everywhere in the game, so I left it. He needs to decide whether it changes.
- **Screen 40 content:** four of the five notes are the same "Polish pass" sentence. That is note content, not layout. It needs removing from the What's New note list (at most 3 items).
- **All cards:**
  - They have no close X.
  - They have no key-cap hint footer.
  - "How did that run feel +" should move to a footer ghost button.
  - "Copy report" is a developer action.
  - The ghost button border is too faint.

Next run starts from the notes in `notes/ui/end-cards.md`. I also logged the changes in `notes/ui/changes.md`.

TASK PARTIAL: every end card is at 3 or below. The `$` to SP ruling, the duplicate What's New notes and the shared close X and hint footer remain. Screens 76 and 77 are still unscored.
